style: Copy accepted identity image exactly: head/body proportions, coat markings, brown eyes, ear shapes, clean dark outline and restrained cel shading. Two-legged compact SD animal, short arms legs, rounded paws with small digit lines. No clothes shoes props shadows lettering grids or environment. Reference motion image is POSE ONLY, never copy its species or colors. European rabbit: warm gray-brown coat, cream muzzle chest belly paws, long upright rounded ears dusty pink inside, short white fluffy tail. Preserve rabbit ears and head size in every frame; never replace with dog ears. All animals: NO paw pads, NO toe beans, NO internal circular/oval sole or palm markings, NO emphasized sole plane.
